headline: Sony brings new AI upscaling tech to the base PS5
summary: Sony introduced Quick Spectral Super Resolution, a new AI upscaling technology for the base PS5 developed through its Project Amethyst collaboration with AMD. Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei are the first games confirmed to support the new upscaling tier.

claims.statement: Sony introduced Quick Spectral Super Resolution, a new AI upscaling tech for the base PS5, developed via its Project Amethyst work with AMD.
